import math

# Public debt securities held by U.S. government (column 5) - in millions
govt_held = [1320784, 1447001, 1598459, 1765580, 1989072]

print("Public debt securities held by U.S. government (millions):")
for i, v in enumerate(govt_held):
    print(f"  {1995+i}: {v}")

print("\nPublic debt securities held by the public (millions):")
for i, v in enumerate(public_held):
    print(f"  {1995+i}: {v}")

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates
# Log growth rate = ln(value_t / value_{t-1})

def calc_log_growth_rates(data):
    rates = []
    for i in range(1, len(data)):
        rate = math.log(data[i] / data[i-1])
        rates.append(rate)
    return rates

govt_rates = calc_log_growth_rates(govt_held)
public_rates = calc_log_growth_rates(public_held)

print("\nYear-to-year log growth rates (govt held):")
for i, r in enumerate(govt_rates):
    print(f"  {1996+i}/{1995+i}: {r:.6f}")

print("\nYear-to-year log growth rates (public held):")
for i, r in enumerate(public_rates):
    print(f"  {1996+i}/{1995+i}: {r:.6f}")

# Calculate mean and population standard deviation
def calc_mean(data):
    return sum(data) / len(data)

def calc_pop_std(data):
    mean = calc_mean(data)
    variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in data) / len(data)
    return math.sqrt(variance)

# For govt held
govt_mean = calc_mean(govt_rates)

public_cv = public_std / public_mean

# Absolute difference
